decisions.question: N lookback counting
decisions.normative_interpretation: Count exact calendar-day offsets; weekends and missing-data days occupy offsets and are not replaced by older valid sessions.

decisions.question: Reference reuse across later stages
decisions.normative_interpretation: A reference side remains eligible across later check windows until the protected symbol touches that same side; hunter touch alone does not globally consume it.

decisions.question: Confirmation crossing session boundary
decisions.normative_interpretation: The confirmation candle must close inside the owning check session; otherwise the candidate expires and is never transferred to the next session.

decisions.question: First-sweep time authority
decisions.normative_interpretation: Historical and live first-sweep ordering use M1 only; ticks do not change the canonical winner.

decisions.question: Confirmation timeframe
decisions.normative_interpretation: Use the current chart timeframe, resolve it at initialization, and include the resolved timeframe in configuration and signal identity.

decisions.question: Weekly window boundary
decisions.normative_interpretation: Build weekly windows in America/New_York time from Sunday 18:00 inclusive to Friday 17:00 exclusive, DST-aware and broker-independent.

decisions.question: WW lifecycle neutralization
decisions.normative_interpretation: A previously asymmetric weekly context becomes neutralized when the second symbol touches the corresponding weekly side; historical evidence is retained.

decisions.question: WW tradeability
decisions.normative_interpretation: WW is both a directional gate for lower relations and an independently executable setup, subject to the same risk, quota, and geometry controls.

decisions.question: No active WW behavior
decisions.normative_interpretation: When weekly data is valid but no active WW exists, both directions are permitted. Missing weekly data remains a distinct fail-closed data state.

decisions.question: Opposing WW conflict
decisions.normative_interpretation: The most recently confirmed, still-active WW controls direction. Older opposite WW events remain in the ledger but are not the active gate.

decisions.question: Session quota scope
decisions.normative_interpretation: Across the two symbols and all relations, only the first eligible entry in each A/L/N session may proceed.

decisions.question: Quota consumption moment
decisions.normative_interpretation: Owner requested clarification. Detection, drawing, arbitration, and reservation can be implemented; permanent quota consumption for live execution must remain configurable or disabled until frozen.

decisions.question: Simultaneous signal priority
decisions.normative_interpretation: The primary winner is the candidate with the earliest canonical M1 hunt time. Stable technical tie-breaks apply only when hunt timestamps are equal.

decisions.question: SELL stop spread adjustment
decisions.normative_interpretation: For SELL trades, protective stop equals the raw structural stop plus one contemporaneous spread snapshot; risk sizing uses the adjusted stop distance.

decisions.question: Suppressed signal drawing
decisions.normative_interpretation: Signals suppressed by WW, quota, data state, or execution eligibility remain visible with distinct color/opacity/style and explicit reason codes.
